skills.name: release-guide
skills.description: Prepare and publish a versioned software release.
skills.instructions:
# Release
Check the changelog, sign the tag, and verify artifact provenance. Use staged rollout with a canary deployment. Revert to the previous build if health checks fail.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Write release announcements and changelog summaries.
skills.instructions:
# Release notes
Group changes by user impact. Summarize breaking changes and migration steps. Do not publish packages or deploy builds.

skills.name: database-recovery
skills.description: Restore a database after an operational incident.
skills.instructions:
# Recovery
Recover deleted rows using point-in-time recovery and a transaction log. Restore into an isolated database, validate row counts, and obtain approval before replacing production data.

skills.name: database-migration
skills.description: Plan and apply database schema migrations.
skills.instructions:
# Schema changes
Use expand-contract migrations for zero-downtime schema changes. Check constraints and backward compatibility. This is not an incident recovery procedure.

skills.name: presentation-builder
skills.instructions:
# Presentations
Build a slide deck in PowerPoint. Include speaker notes and accessible charts. Export a PDF handout.

skills.name: pdf-review
skills.description: Inspect document layout and exported PDF files.
skills.instructions:
# PDF review
Render pages to images. Check clipping, missing fonts, page breaks, and chart labels. This does not create slide decks.

skills.name: accessibility-audit
skills.description: Review web interfaces for accessibility defects.
skills.instructions:
# Accessibility
Test keyboard navigation, screen-reader announcements, focus order, and color contrast. Verify WCAG conformance and accessible names.

skills.name: browser-performance
skills.description: Measure and improve web application performance.
skills.instructions:
# Performance
Record LCP, INP, and CLS. Investigate long tasks, layout shifts, and slow rendering. Use a repeatable browser profile.

skills.name: repository-triage
skills.description: Triage issues and pull requests in a software repository.
skills.instructions:
# Triage
Identify duplicate bug reports, verify reproductions, and assign an owner. Preserve contributor credit. Do not close an issue based only on similar wording.

skills.name: incident-response
skills.instructions:
# Incidents
Stop the bleeding, establish an incident commander, and maintain a timeline. Escalate an outage and communicate recovery status.

skills.name: image-editing
skills.description: Edit raster images and prepare visual assets.
skills.instructions:
# Images
Remove the background from a product photograph. Preserve transparency in PNG exports and inspect edge artifacts.

skills.name: invoice-processing
skills.instructions:
# Invoices
Extract invoice line items, tax amounts, purchase-order references, and payment terms. Flag discrepancies for review.
